sentences.text: I am contesting ticket 4483 920 117, issued on October 1, 2026 at 12:10 PM at W 45 St & 6 Ave, Manhattan, to plate GCR 4471, for a commercial meter zone violation with no paid receipt.
I state that the meter where I parked on 45th Street was not working, and the attached photo shows the meter with a blank screen.
Because the meter was not working, I paid for parking through the ParkNYC app, and the attached receipt shows a payment at 11:52 AM for two hours.
I state that I made this payment on the day of the ticket, so the ticket time of 12:10 PM falls within the two hours I paid for.
I respectfully ask that this ticket be dismissed.
